data.description: Acacia Avenues is a cluster of residential skyscrapers and luxury white villas in the heart of Al Sufouh.

data.answer:
Located strategically in Al Sufouh, this community benefits from its proximity to major business hubs, entertainment destinations, and educational institutions, positioning it as a prime location for families and professionals alike. The development features a blend of luxurious villas and stylish apartments, each designed with attention to detail and comfort. 

The area’s architecture is a modern interpretation of traditional Arabian styles, ensuring privacy while promoting a sense of community. Acacia Avenue provides a tranquil yet connected living experience with its landscaped gardens and scenic walking paths.

Acacia Avenues is an exclusive community distinguished by its variety of modern residences, ranging from high-rise apartments to expansive villas, each designed with luxury and functionality in mind.

Acacia Avenues offers meticulously designed properties with high-end finishes, providing residents with a luxurious and comfortable living experience. Its prime location and diverse property options make it a highly desirable area for both investors and homebuyers seeking premium living in Dubai.

Properties for Rent in Acacia Avenue

Are you looking for apartments for rent in Dubai? Those interested in renting in Acacia Avenues have a variety of options, from studio apartments to more spacious villas for rent. Residential units come with amenities like shared swimming pools, gyms, and family recreation areas, many boasting magnificent views of Burj Al Arab and the Arabian Gulf. 

Studios start at AED 39k per annum, 1-bedroom flats range from AED 60k to AED 72k, and 2-bedroom apartments from AED 75k to AED 85k annually. Studio sizes range from 470 sq. ft. to over 620 sq. ft., 1-bedrooms from 760 sq. ft. to 1,050 sq. ft., and 2-bedrooms from 1,223 sq. ft. to 1,400 sq. ft.

For those seeking more privacy and space, 6-bed villas spanning 5,000 sq. ft. to 7,000 sq. ft. are available, costing around AED 1M per annum, although options may be limited. Additional 2 to 6-bed villas can also be found throughout the master development in Al Sufouh.

Properties for Sale in Acacia Avenue

In Acacia Avenues, located in Al Sufouh, Hilliana Tower and Bahia Residence stand out as significant options for potential investors seeking apartments for sale. The pricing for studios in the community starts around AED 500k, while 1-bedroom apartments are priced between AED 850k and AED 1M. 

Those interested in a 2-bedroom apartments can expect prices ranging from AED 1.1M to AED 1.8M. Additionally, the community offers spacious villas; 4-bedroom villas span 4,900 sq. ft. to 5,405 sq. ft. and are priced from AED 6M to AED 8M, whereas 5-bedroom villas, ranging from 5,500 sq. ft. to 8,490 sq. ft., cost between AED 6.5M and AED 8.2M, providing a range of luxurious living options.

more_info.question: What to Expect When Living in Acacia Avenue

data.answer:
Living on Acacia Avenue means experiencing the top of luxury every day. Residents enjoy access to exclusive clubs, private beaches, and gourmet restaurants, all within a secure and pristine environment. The community is designed for those who appreciate finer details and a quality lifestyle.

Public Transportation in Acacia Avenue

Acacia Avenue offers a secluded ambiance but remains well-connected, making public transportation quite convenient for its residents. The nearest metro stations, Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Internet City Metro Station, are both just a 10-minute drive away. Additionally, several bus routes serve the area, with nearby bus stops including Dubai College-01 and Abdulla Omran Taryam Street 1. 

Supermarkets in Acacia Avenue

Residents of Acacia Avenues have a wealth of options for their grocery needs, all conveniently located nearby. The Emirates Cooperative Society, the closest supermarket, offers a wide variety of grocery products along with discount deals and a free home delivery service. 

Other nearby supermarkets include West Zone Fresh Supermarket, Sun N Moon Minimart, and Carryfood Supermarket. Additionally, well-known chains like Spinneys and Waitrose are just a 5-minute drive away, providing multiple choices for daily essentials.

Shopping Malls Near Acacia Avenue

Residents of Acacia Avenues enjoy convenient access to major shopping destinations like the Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Marina Mall. Just a 10-minute drive away, these malls offer a rich mix of international and local retail brands, dining options, and entertainment facilities such as Ski Dubai and VOX Cinemas. Whether it's luxury shopping at high-end brands or enjoying leisure activities, these malls provide everything residents might need close to home.

Schools in and Near Acacia Avenue

Several reputable schools are conveniently located near Acacia Avenues, offering top-notch educational opportunities. GEMS Wellington International School, situated in Al Sufouh 1 and just a 4-minute drive from Acacia Avenues, offers a UK/IB curriculum and is rated outstanding by KHDA.

 Nearby, the International School of Choueifat provides education based on the SABIS curriculum. Moreover, GEMS Dubai American Academy is another excellent option in the area, following an American curriculum.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Acacia Avenue

Acacia Avenues is surrounded by diverse places of worship catering to different faiths, all within convenient driving distances. Several mosques, including Masjid Shaikh Ahmed Bin Rashed Al Maktoum, Fatemah Marzouq Al Rashdan Mosque, and Tecom Masjid, are just a 5 to 8-minute drive away. 

Christian residents have access to Emirates Baptist Church, Casa de Oracion Torre Fuerte Church, and Fellowship Church, approximately 10 minutes away by car. Sikh community members can reach Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara within 15 minutes. Additionally, ShrinathJi Temple, serving the Hindu community, is located in Bur Dubai, about a 30-minute drive from Acacia Avenues.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Acacia Avenue

Residents of Acacia Avenues have convenient access to a variety of medical facilities. Al Zahra Hospital Dubai, located nearest to the community, provides medical services, including cardiology, dermatology, and neurology. Other accessible hospitals include Saudi German Hospital and American Hospital Clinic. 

For more routine medical needs, nearby clinics like MAG Clinic, Angel Wings Medical Center, and Aster Clinic serve the community. Additionally, pet owners can visit Lucky Veterinary Clinic in Al Barsha, an 8-minute drive away, ensuring healthcare needs for all family members are met within close proximity.

Acacia Avenue Location & Nearby Areas

Strategically located, Acacia Avenue is close to Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah, about 10 minutes away, placing it near some of the city’s most vibrant and popular areas.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Acacia Avenue

data.answer:
Acacia Avenue offers a plethora of activities to engage its residents. From exploring the nearby lush parks and enjoying family picnics to visiting upscale cafes and restaurants for culinary delights, the community also hosts various social and cultural events, making it a vibrant place to live and socialize.

Restaurants In and Near Acacia Avenue

Residents of Acacia Avenues enjoy easy access to a diverse array of dining options, with numerous restaurants located nearby, including independent eateries, fast food chains, and various options housed within local malls and hotels.

Notable restaurants such as The Cheesecake Factory, Hanaaya Restaurant, Pierchic, Zheng He’s, Nando’s, Spinzer, P.F. Chang’s, Trattoria Toscana, Koreana Restaurant, Tribes, and Pai Thai are all conveniently reachable within a quick 10 to 12-minute drive, offering a range of culinary experiences from local delicacies to international cuisine.

Beaches Near Acacia Avenue

Residents of Acacia Avenues can enjoy quick and easy access to several nearby beaches for a relaxing day out. Al Sufouh Beach, known for its serene ambiance and relatively uncrowded setting, is just a 9-minute drive away. Additionally, Jumeirah Beach and Umm Suqeim Public Beach are also close by, providing more options for beachgoers seeking sun, sand, and sea in the vicinity.

Hotels in Acacia Avenue

A few minutes away are hotels like ibis Dubai Al Barsha and Rose Park Hotel - Al Barsha, Dubai. Burj Al Arab, one of the most notable luxury hotels in Dubai is located 9 minutes away from Acacia Avenue. Positioned on a man-made island, the famous landmark boasts a unique sail-shaped structure. The hotel offers panoramic views of the Arabian Sea while providing top-notch services, fine-dining restaurants, and a royal experience to hotel guests.

Attractions and Landmarks in and Near Acacia Avenue

Located just 10 minutes away by car from Acacia Avenue, Emirates Golf Club offers world-class golfing facilities and breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline. It’s a premier destination for golf enthusiasts and those looking to enjoy fine dining at one of its luxury restaurants.

A 12-minute drive from Acacia Avenue, Marina Walk is a bustling promenade along Dubai Marina. It's the perfect spot for a leisurely stroll, dining by the waterfront, or enjoying some of Dubai's best cafes and boutiques.

Just 15 minutes away by car, Palm Jumeirah is a stunning man-made island that features luxury hotels, pristine beaches, and upscale dining. It's a must-visit destination for residents and tourists alike, offering a perfect mix of relaxation and entertainment.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Residents of Acacia Avenues can enjoy a delightful evening at Al Sufouh Park, just a 6-minute drive away, featuring a children's play area, a small football ground, a basketball court, and a jogging track. 

Although smaller than other Dubai parks, it's perfect for family picnics. For fitness enthusiasts, nearby gyms include Snap Fitness 24-7, Al Barsha Gym, and Crunch Fitness. Additionally, a variety of salons and spas are available in the area, such as Pine Spa, Talise Spa, Kaizo Beauty Salon and Spa, NStyle Beauty Lounge, Sasha Beauty Salon, and Galina’s Beauty Salon, providing ample options for relaxation and personal care.
While Acacia Avenue offers privacy and luxury, the price point may be a consideration for some. However, the quality of life and investment value it offers often outweigh the initial cost.

What types of properties are available in Acacia Avenue?

Acacia Avenue offers a variety of properties, including luxury apartments and spacious villas, each designed with modern aesthetics and high-quality finishes.

What are the public transportation options on Acacia Avenue?

The area is serviced by several bus routes, and the nearest metro station is just a 10-minute drive away, facilitating convenient access to the rest of Dubai.

Can you find medical facilities near Acacia Avenue?

Yes, there are numerous clinics and hospitals nearby, including Saudi German Hospital and Al Zahra Hospital, both within a 15-minute drive.

What leisure facilities are available to residents of Acacia Avenue?

Residents can enjoy various amenities, including private beaches, exclusive clubs, state-of-the-art gyms, and community swimming pools.

What are the nearby attractions for residents of Acacia Avenue?

Residents can easily access Dubai’s famous landmarks such as Madinat Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, and Dubai Marina, all located within a 15-minute drive.

What security measures are in place on Acacia Avenue?

Acacia Avenue ensures a safe environment with 24/7 security, controlled access, and surveillance systems throughout the community.

Are any furnished apartments available in Acacia Avenues, Al Sufouh?

Acacia Avenues in Al Sufouh offers a range of furnished apartments, providing ready-to-move-in options from studios to multi-bedroom units. These apartments come equipped with high-quality furniture and modern appliances, ideal for those seeking convenient and luxurious living in Dubai.

data.content:
Acacia Avenues in Dubai stands out as an exclusive, gated community, offering a serene yet sophisticated living experience. Situated in a prime location, it provides easy access to Dubai's major attractions, including beaches, malls, and business centers.
The community features a mix of modern villas, townhouses, and apartments, each designed with luxury and comfort in mind. These residences boast spacious interiors, high-quality finishes, and contemporary architectural styles, complemented by lush landscaping and scenic views.

Residents of Acacia Avenues enjoy a host of amenities such as swimming pools, fitness centers, children's play areas, and community parks. The area is also known for its tranquility and privacy, making it a preferred choice for families and professionals alike.
